finding_summary: For the standard rate-one-pair Kingman coalescent, \(\operatorname{Cov}(C_n,E_n)=-2/9\) for every \(n\ge4\), while the covariance vanishes at \(n=2,3\). The partial-state dependence is an explicit strictly negative rational kernel for all nontrivial states.

integrity.finite_checks: 2201 exact abstract-state comparisons and exhaustive labeled histories through seven leaves
integrity.proof: closed rational three-transition induction with explicit small-size boundary

scientific_limitations: Requires constant unit merging rate for each unordered pair; a global rate change rescales branch lengths and covariance.
Does not cover multiple-merger coalescents, variable population sizes, or negative association of the full statistics.
Historical priority remains uncertain despite inspected primary results and semantic overlap checks.
title: Size-independent cherry–external-length covariance in Kingman's coalescent
